tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// sman bla'i mdo chog snying po gzhan phan bde 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru madzñu shrī ye/ bla ma rnams dang skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum// bde gshegs bdun dang thub dbang 'jam dbyangs la// btud nas bde gshegs bdun gyi mdo sde yi// cho ga'i snying po gzhan phan bde 'jug bri// 'dir snyigs ma'i dus 'dir byin rlabs shin tu che ba sman bla'i mdo chog gi snying po nyams su len par 'dod pas/ sbyor ba phyi nang gi khrus sogs kyis 'gal rkyen bsal la/ dus khyad par can nya stong tshes brgyad dam/ de min gang yang rung bar gnas khang byi dor byas/ spos kyi maṇḍal zhes dkyil 'khor ram/ sman bla'i pho brang blos bslang sogs bkod pa'i mdun du bum pa sum gnyis chus bkang nang bum rdzas nyer lnga kha rgyan dang bcas pa bshams mthar sku gzugs re re la mar me dang tshon sna lnga pa'i ba dan bdun bdun bya dgos par gsungs pa rnams gtso gyur gyi spos dang me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa ci 'byor pa bsham/ stan bde ba la 'khod nas dge sems khyad par can bskyed de dngos gzhi 'di ltar nyams su blang ngo*/

'dir long yod na theg chen gso sbyong len tshul gzhan du shes dgos shing de ltar min yang gtsang sbra'i kun spyod la gnas pa gal che'o/ ༈ /rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag pos thog drangs/ sems can thams cad bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// chos la skyabs su mchi'o// dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla bde bar gshegs pa mched brgyad kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// bdun nam gsum brjod/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos tshogs yi dam la// byang chub bar du gus pas bdag skyabs mchi// 'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir// phun tshogs mdo sde'i cho ga bsgrub par bgyi// gsum brjod/ ma sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das bde bar gshegs pa brgyad kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la phyag mchod thugs dam bskul ba la sogs pa'i lam gyi rim pa la gnas par bya'o// bdag dang snang ba thams cad chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin yin pa la/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bya/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar bya/ sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar bya/ bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par bya'o// sa gzhi byin rlabs/ dkyil 'khor byin rlabs/ gdan khri byin rlabs/ mchod pa byin rlabs te byin rlabs bzhi skor du grags pa'i don sgom bzhin du 'di ltar/ spyi sgos dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*// chos dbyings rnam dag tshogs gnyis lhag bsam mthus// ma dag 'khrul ba'i las snang rags pa kun// nub nas dag pa'i snang bar gyur pa ni// rnam dag zhing gi phun tshogs kun bsdus pa'i// yid 'phrog sa gzhi rin chen bye bas brgyan// yon tan mang ldan dag gsal chu mtsho dang*// dpag bsam ljon pas phyogs kun brgyan par shog

/de dbus gzhal med khang chen bde gshegs gnas// rin chen bdun bkod phyi nang kun tu gsal// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dge legs kyis// legs par brgyan pa'i khang bzang grub gyur cig /de nang rin chen las grub seng ge'i khrir// padma'i snying por bde gshegs dam pa'i chos// 'phags tshogs so so'i mnga' thang ji bzhin du// gdan khri mdzes pa sha stag 'byung gyur cig /phyi nang kun tu rang rang cha rim bzhin// mchod sprin bsam yas phung po gsum pa yi// mdo dang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam bzhin// grub nas dgyes bzhin legs par spyod gyur cig /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badzra sā ra pra marda ne/ ta thā ga tā ya arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre/ ma hā badzre/ ma hā te dzwa badzre/ ma hā bidya badzre/ ma hā bo dhi tsitta badzre/ ma hā bo dhi maṇḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badzre sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na badzre swā hā/ mchod sprin gyi gzungs 'di tshar gsum brjod/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs dang tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis de bzhin nyid du gyur cig lan gsum/ de nas spyan 'dren ni/ ston pas sangs rgyas zhing bskul ting 'dzin gyis// bde gshegs bdun po mngon sum spyan drangs ltar// dad mos thugs rjes bde gshegs 'khor bcas rnams// 'dir gshegs rang rang gdan la bzhugs su gsol// gshegs byon skye 'chi med pa'i sku// ji ltar smon zhi yod pa ltar// dkar po 'char ba'i tshul bzhin du// 'jig rten skyabs su gshegs su gsol// bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gis phul ba'i mchod yon 'di// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// khyed kyi rang bzhin yongs dag pas// srid sogs 'chi ba mi mnga' yang*// bdag cag sgrib pa sbyang slad du// gtsang ma chab kyis sku khrus gsol// de bzhin gshegs pa de yi sras rnams la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos// mi phyed rdo rje'i sku brnyes la// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog

/'gro ba nyon mongs skom gyis gdungs pa la// chos kyi chu yis tshim par bya ba'i phyir// nyes bral sgrub pa'i don la dmigs nas kyang*// bdag gis khyed la bum chu dbul bar bgyi// chos ston dag pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// dpal chen dag pa'i gdan bshams te// ting 'dzin mi g.yo mnyam bzhag pas// dgyes par dgongs te gdan la bzhugs// gtsang dang gdan khri yangs pa la// thogs dang dog pa med pa'i sku// mnyam nyid tshul gyis bzhugs nas kyang*// bde bar sbyar ba bzhes su gsol// so so'i zhing khams nas rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la gshegs te byin gyis brlabs pa'i gzhal med khang gi nang du bzhugs par gyur/ sbyin pa'i bdag pos thog drangs sems can thams cad kyang zham 'bring gi tshul du lhags te pho brang gi phyi rol nas mchod pa 'bul zhing gsol ba 'debs par gyur/ spyi mchod yan lag bdun pa'i dang po phyag 'tshal ba ni/ gang gi zhabs pad bsten pa'i bka' drin las// ngan 'gro srid zhi'i skyon yon rig gyur nas// skyes bu'i don la sems pa'i skabs rnyed pa// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gang rnams rim par brgyud pa'i bka' drin las// sngon tshe rgyal bas gsungs pa'i phan bde'i lam// shin tu rnyed dka' bdag gis rnyed gyur pa// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po zas gtsang sras// blo chen gsung gi dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs// de sras gangs can dpal mgon zhi ba 'tsho// bka' drin mtshungs med gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// bod 'bangs thugs kyi dkyil bzung khri srong sde// de sras mu ne btsan dang sad na legs// chos sems gtsang ma'i zhabs dang 'od kyis bsrungs// snga dar chos rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan dang nyi ma mgon// bkra shis lde dang lha btsun khu dbon gnyis// zhi ba 'od dang 'od lde rtse lde'i zhabs// phyi dar chos rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mnga' ris snar dang zhu lhan chu lhad pa// gro mo che dang sgom seng nam mkha' grags// tshad ma'i skyes bu bu ston yab sras sogs// mkhas grub bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// snying po

gnyags rgyal mtshan kun sprang lung*/ smon spang khang grags pa dpal bzang*/ pa// zhang bsod grags/ ston grags chos lung mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan dang rin chen rgyal mtshan gnyis/ pa rin chen rgyal mtshan zung*// rgyal ba phyag na kun blo tshul khrims dpal// 'khrul zhig dpal 'bar rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang phyug rab brtan bka' 'gyur bsod nams mchog ldan/ pa// bsod zha lu mkhan chen/ mchog rgyal dbang gong sa lnga ba/ 'jam grags dge slong ngag dbang brtan/ la mo zhabs drung*/ /'phags chen rin don lce btsun phrin las rje// dzñā na'i mtshan can rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gangs can phan bde'i dpal 'byor 'byung ba'i sgo// sman mchog kun gyis sgrub tu rung ba'i lam// chos rgyal thugs dam mdo sde'i cho ga 'di// 'dzin skyong spel mdzad rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// don gnyis mthar phyin ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas// bden gnyis zung 'jug bstan pa dam pa'i chos// tshogs gnyis nyams len 'phags mchog dge 'dun te// skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// shar phyogs gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed na// gzhan gyis mi thub rnam dag zhing gi dpal// bgrang yas sems dpas bskor ba'i bcom ldan 'das// mtshan legs yongs bsgrags dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// shar phyogs gaṅgā'i klung bdun bye snyed na// rin chen ldan pa'i rnam dag zhing gi dpal// bgrang yas sems dpas bskor ba'i bcom ldan 'das// rin chen zla ba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// shar phyogs gaṅgā'i klung lnga'i bye snyed na// spos kyis yongs gang rnam dag zhing gi dpal// bgrang yas sems dpas bskor ba'i bcom ldan 'das// gser bzang dri ma snang la phyag 'tshal lo// shar phyogs gaṅgā'i klung bdun bye snyed na// mya ngan bral ba'i rnam dag zhing gi dpal// bgrang yas sems dpas bskor ba'i bcom ldan 'das// mya ngan med mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// shar phyogs gaṅgā'i klung brgyad bye snyed na// chos kyi rgyal mtshan rnam dag zhing gi dpal// bgrang yas sems dpas bskor ba'i bcom ldan 'das// chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// shar phyogs gaṅgā'i klung dgu'i bye snyed na// rin chen rgya mtsho'i rnam dag zhing gi dpal// bgrang yas sems dpas bskor ba'i bcom ldan 'das// mngon mkhyen rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// shar phyogs gaṅgā'i klung bcu'i bye snyed na// bai ḍūrya'i snang rnam dag zhing gi dpal// bgrang yas sems dpas bskor ba'i bcom ldan 'das// sman gyi bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi sku ni ind+ra nī la'i mdog

/mtshan dpe nyi ma'i 'od stong 'bar ba'i mkha'// kun la zhi bde'i go skabs 'byed pa'i dbyings// bcom ldan sman bla'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi gsung ni dri za'i rgyud stong ltar// tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis sna tshogs gdul bya'i yid// kun tu tshim byed gsung rab rgya mtsho'i gter// bcom ldan sman bla'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi thugs ni ye shes rgya mtsho'i ngang*// dmigs med thugs rje'i rba rlabs cher g.yos shing*// smon lam rgya mtsho mdzad pa lhun grub pa'i// bcom ldan sman bla'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje brtson 'grus mchog gi rtser gshegs pas// snyigs dus rgyal ba gzhan gyis mi dul ba'i// mi mjed tshe lo brgya pa'i zhing gi dpal// 'dren mchog shākya'i tog la phyag 'tshal lo// kun 'byung mun pa'i sa bon mthar mdzad cing*// sdug bsngal zug rngu'i rtsa ba drung nas 'byin// rgyal yum shes rab pha rol phyin la sogs// theg gsum dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan sman bla'i dam chos mdzod 'dzin cing*// nyi zla lta bur 'gro la snang byed sogs// bde gshegs bdun gyi 'khor du 'dus pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// thub dbang 'khor gyi gtso bo rgyal ba'i sras// mkhyen brtse nus pa phul du phyin pa po// spyan ras gzigs dang blo gros chen po sogs// sum khri drug stong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// yangs pa can du bde gshegs spyan snga ru// bstan dang bstan 'dzin srung bar zhal bzhes pa'i// tshangs pa brgya byin 'jig rten skyong ba sogs// lha yi dge bsnyen rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gdul bya'i don du thabs kyis sku sprul zhing*// bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan srung dge bsnyen mchog /bdun 'bum 'khor gyis bskor ba'i bcu gnyis po// gnod sbyin sde dpon rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' khyab zhing gi phyag 'os thams cad la// yon tan zhing du lhag par mos pa'i blos// 'gro kun zhing rdul grangs snyed lus sprul nas// sangs rgyas zhing mthar rtag tu gus phyag 'tshal// ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun// bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la// lus dang ngag yid dwang bas phyag bgyi'o// bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis// rgyal ba thams cad yid kyi mngon sum du// zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis// rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo// rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams// sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag

/de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa// thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos// de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams// dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis// rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing*// bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod// gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ ༈ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mchod rdzas las grub pa'i// zhing khams rgya mtsho'i mchod yon rgya mtsho'i tshogs// yon tan rgya mtsho'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas la// dad pa rgya mtshos 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// zhes mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams/ kha spos la 'bul/ rgyal ba zag med 'byor la mnga' bsgyur yang*// 'gro ba'i don du 'dod yon rnam lnga yis// mchod pas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis// bsod nams mi zad gter la spyod par shog /mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus la// bsam bzhin yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis// 'gro ba mi zad gter la longs spyod shog /phun tshogs bkra shis dge mtshan ma lus kun// gcig tu rab 'khyil yid 'ong rtags brgyad rdzas// bcom ldan sman bla'i lha tshogs la phul bas// phyogs kun dge legs chen pos khyab par shog /de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal sim byed pa'i// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang*// sil snyan rnams dang byug pa gdugs mchog dang*// mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang*// phye ma phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang*// bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba// de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos// bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis// rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi// gsum pa bshags pa'i don du ltung bshags tshar gsum 'don/

bsdu na/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni// lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang*// sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras// rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang*// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang*// gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma rnams// byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes// mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la// 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul// mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la// 'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir// bskal ba zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang*// bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi// phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yis// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o// yan lag lhag ma rnams bya'o// de nas thugs dam bskul zhing mtshan gyi phyag mchod ni/ bcom ldan 'das gdan 'dzoms pa chen po dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag dus ngan pa'i sems can las kyi sgrib pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs pa/ nad dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses shing phongs pa rnams la sngon sangs rgyas bdun gyis thugs brtse bas smon lam ji ltar btab pa dang*/ ston pa shākya thub pas bka' stsal zhing byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ lha'i dge bsnyen rnams kyis phrin las mdzad par ji ltar zhal gyis bzhes pa la sogs pa phan yon mtha' dag bdag cag gis 'phral du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ༈ /bdag cag dus ngan sems can bskyab pa'i phyir// bde gshegs rnams kyis smon lam gang btab dang*// thub dbang sras dang bka' sdod bcas pa yis// bka' stsal zhal bzhes mtha' dag 'grub gyur cig

༈ /dang po mtshan legs ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// lan bdun brjod/ gser gyi mdog can skyabs sbyin phyag rgya can// smon lam brgyad grub tshogs gnyis dpal gyis brjid// gzhan gyis mi thub zhing gi dpal gyur pa'i// mtshan legs yongs bsgrags dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan gyi me tog rgyas shing dag pa la// dpe byad bzang po'i 'bru chags mdzes pa'i sku// gang gis mthong thos dran pa'i dpal gyur pa'i// ston pa mtshan legs dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod pa kun 'bul sdig pa mtha' dag bshags// dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// dge rtsa rdzogs byang nyid du bsngo bar bgyi// mtshan legs rgyal por mtshan bzlas phyag mchod mthus// rgyal ba mchog des sngon tshe gzhan don du// nad gdon rim sogs 'jigs pa mtha' dag zhi// 'on long smyo sogs sdug bsngal nad rgyun chad// dmyal ba'i las zad lha mi'i bde ba myong*// dbul phongs kun kyang dbyig sogs yo byad 'phel// bcing dang rdeg sogs lus gdung mtha' dag zhi// mgon med dug sbrul sogs kyis gtses las thar// 'thab rtsod 'gyed rnams phan tshun byams sems ldan// chus khyer smre sngags 'don rnams dbugs phyin shog /ces pa'i smon lam chen po rnam pa brgyad// bdag sogs 'gro bas myur du 'grub par shog /shi 'phos dag pa'i zhing der padma las// brdzus skyes yon tan kun rdzogs de la sogs// rgyal ba kun mnyes skad cig skad cig la// sangs rgyas zhing kun bgrod pa'i mthu thob shog /bcom ldan mtshan legs yongs bsgrags rgyal po yis// sngon tshe smon lam rnam brgyad btab pa'i 'bras// dpag med mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i byin rlabs kyis// deng 'dir bdag sogs 'gro bas longs spyod shog

/ces pa'i smon lam chen po bcu gnyis po// bdag sogs 'gro bas myur du 'grub par shog /shi 'phos dag pa'i zhing der padma las// brdzus skyes yon tan kun rdzogs de la sogs// rgyal ba kun mnyes skad cig skad cig la// sangs rgyas zhing kun bgrod pa'i mthu thob shog /bcom ldan sman bla bai ḍūrya 'od kyis// sngon tshe smon lam bcu gnyis btab pa'i 'bras// dpag med mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i byin rlabs kyis// deng 'dir bdag sogs 'gro bas longs spyod shog /thub pa'i bstan dar skye rgu bde zhing skyid// bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe brtan pa dang*// 'gro rnams sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis po// rab rdzogs byang chen myur du thob byin rlobs/ ༈ /brgyad pa bdag cag gi ston pa shākya'i rgyal po ni/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// bco lnga bzla/ mtshan gyi grangs ka brjod tshul 'di snar thang gi mchims thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag len nges pa can yin gsung ngo*// gser gyi mdog can sa gnon mnyam gzhag can// smon lam mthar phyin mdzad pa lhun grub cing*// mi mjed gdul dka'i zhing gi dpal gyur pa'i// ston mchog shākya'i tog la phyag 'tshal lo// thabs mkhas thugs rjes shākya'i rigs 'khrungs shing*// gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa// gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku// shākya'i rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod pa kun 'bul sdig pa mtha' dag bshags// dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// dge rtsa rdzogs byang nyid du bsngo bar bgyi// shākya'i rgyal por phyag 'tshal mchod pa'i mthus// rgyal ba mchog des snyigs dus 'gro ba'i slad// bde gshegs bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam dang*// cho ga'i bsam sbyor khyad par can rnams gsungs// brgyad ka 'dzoms nas bai ḍūr gzungs chen gyi// phan yon gsungs nas tshul 'dir bskul ba ltar// deng 'dir 'bad las legs tshogs gang 'thob pa// bdag sogs 'gro bas myur du 'grub par shog

/de bzhin gshegs pa khyed sku ci 'dra dang*// 'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang*// khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba// de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs 'gyur bar shog /bcom ldan mnyam med shākya thub pa yis// bai ḍūrya gzungs phan yon gsungs pa'i 'bras// dpag med mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i byin rlabs kyis// deng 'dir bdag sogs 'gro bas longs spyod shog /thub pa'i bstan dar skye rgu bde zhing skyid// bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe brtan pa dang*// 'gro rnams sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis po// rab rdzogs byang chen myur du thob byin rlobs/ ༈ /gnyis pa chos dkon mchog ni/ ma rig mun sel sgron me'i mchog /sdug bsngal nad sel sman gyi phul// dam chos dkon mchog thams cad la// phyag 'tshal mchod cing skyabs su mchi// lan bdun/ chos nyid rgyu mthun gsung rab bcu gnyis mchog /chos la skye 'gag med cing spros pas dben// de la dmigs nas yon tan kun 'grub pa'i// legs rgyu dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo// glo bur dri mas dben pa chos kyi dbyings// sgrib gnyis mun pa sel ba 'phags pa'i lam// chos nyid rtogs pa'i rgyu mthun gsung rab mchog /lung rtogs dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod pa kun 'bul sdig pa mtha' dag bshags// dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// dge rtsa rdzogs byang nyid du bsngo bar bgyi// dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal mchod pa'i mthus// mtshan thos tsam gyis skyon zad yon tan 'phel// zhes sogs bde gshegs bka' lung 'gyur med rnams// bdag sogs 'gro bas myur du 'grub par shog ༈ /gsum pa dge 'dun dkon mchog las 'jam dpal ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa thugs dri ma dang skyon thams cad dang bral ba sku yon tan dri ma med pa'i tshogs kyi 'od zer gyis brgyan pa/

zhabs brten gyi padma la lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang klu dang rig sngags 'chang rnams kyi thor tshugs dang*/ cod pan gyis gtugs pa/ ngan song gi 'gro ba sna tshogs 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum/ chos kyi rgyal bu gzhon nu mkhyen pa'i gter// bdag cag nyes brgyas gzir ba'i 'gro ba la// zab yangs lam 'di mngon du 'gyur mdzad pa// rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod pa kun 'bul sdig pa mtha' dag bshags// dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// dge rtsa rdzogs byang nyid du bsngo bar bgyi// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal mchod pa'i mthus// khyed kyis yon tan bsam yas mdo sde 'di// thub la nan gyis zhus pa'i phan yon kun// bdag sogs 'gro bas myur du 'grub par shog ༈ /skyabs grol ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa skyabs grol la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum/ thabs mkhas thugs rje phul du byung ba'i mthus// dus min 'chi gso rgyal srid spel sogs slad// mchod pa'i sbyor ba gsal bar ston mdzad pa// 'phags pa skyabs grol mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod pa kun 'bul sdig pa mtha' dag bshags// dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// dge rtsa rdzogs byang nyid du bsngo bar bgyi// skyabs grol mdzad la phyag 'tshal mchod pa'i mthus// sman bla'i mtshan gyis nyam thag nad pa dang*// dus min 'chi gso rgyal srid rgyas sogs rnams// bdag sogs 'gro bas myur du 'grub par shog ༈ /phyag rdor sogs ni// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dpal phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs mchi'o// lan gsum/ tshangs pa dang lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po dang mig mi bzang dang*/

ku be ra la sogs pa dam pa chos skyong ba'i lha'i dge bsnyen thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// lan gcig yangs pa can du bde gshegs brgyad 'dzoms nas// spyi sgos bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos shing*// rang rang bden pa'i ngag gis zhal bzhes pa// gsang bdag 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod pa kun 'bul sdig pa mtha' dag bshags// dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// dge rtsa rdzogs byang nyid du bsngo bar bgyi// phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong mdzad lha rnams la// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'dod yon rgya mtshos mchod// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod// gsang bdag mgon dang tshangs dbang rgyal chen sogs// dam can srung mar phyag 'tshal mchod pa'i mthus// mdo 'di spyod sar khyed rnams legs byon nas// srung skyob skyon sel yon tan kun sgrub ces// dam bcas bro bor phan yon mang du bshad// gzungs bstsal phyag rdor sgrub thabs bstan pa kun// bdag sogs 'gro bas myur du 'grub par shog /lhag par bgegs zlog mthun rkyen tshang gyur cig ༈ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon bcu gnyis ni/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po ji 'jigs la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ 1 /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ 2 /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rgyan 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ 3 /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gza' 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ 4 /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rlung la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ 5 /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gnas bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod du skyabs su mchi'o/

6 /gnon sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po dbang 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ 7 /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po btung 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ 8 /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po sgra 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ 9 /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bsam 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ 10 /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po g.yo ba 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ 11 /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rdzogs byed la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ 12 /lan re bzla zhing*/ rgyas par spro tshe 'jam dpal sogs la yang lan bdun re dang*/ tshangs dbang man chad la lan gsum re bya'o// yangs pa can du sman bla'i mtshan thos pas// bden mthong mdo 'di bsrung bar dam bcas pa// bdun 'bum 'khor gyi bskor ba'i bcu gnyis po// gnod sbyin sde dpon rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod pa kun 'bul sdig pa mtha' dag bshags// dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// dge rtsa rdzogs byang nyid du bsngo bar bgyi// gnas srung sde dpon bcu gnyis 'khor bcas la// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'dod yon rgya mtshos mchod// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// nad gdon bar chad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// gnod sbyin rnams la phyag 'tshal mchod pa'i mthus// khyed kyis sman bla'i mtshan thos bden pa mthong*// mdo 'di srung bar dam bcas ji bzhin mdzod// lhag par bgegs zlog mthun rkyen tshang gyur cig /de ltar mtshan phyag dngos gzhi song nas/ mtshams 'dir gzungs sngags bzlas la khrus bya'o// gzungs sngags bzla ba'i dus su dmigs pa ni/ sngags bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis bde bar gshegs pa brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul te sku'i cha thams cad nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung ste bum pa'i chu la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/

tadya thā/ ghu me ghu me/ e mi ni mi hi ma ti sapta ta thā ga ta sa mādhya dhiṣṭhi te/ a te ma te/ pā le pā paṃ sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ nā sha ya ma ma buddhe buddho tta mi/ u me ku me/ buddha kṣe tra pa ri shodha ni/ dha me ni dha me me ru me ru me ru shi kha re/ sarba a kā la mṛ tyu/ ni pā ra ṇi/ buddhe su buddhe buddhe a dhiṣṭhā na rakṣantu me/ sarb+ba de ba/ sa me a sa me sa ma nwā ha rantu/ sarba buddha bodhi sa twa/ sha me sha me pra sha mantu me/ sarba i dyu pa dra ba bya ta yaḥ pū ra ṇe pū ra ṇe pū ra ya me/ sarb+ba ā shā ya/ bai ḍūrya pra ti bhā se sarb+ba pā paṃ kṣa yaṅka ri swā hā/ zhes bai ḍūrya'i gzungs chen dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ bhai ṣa dzye gu ru bai ḍūrya pra bha ra dza ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dzye bhai ṣa dzye ma hā bhai ṣa dzye rā dza sa muṅga te swā hā/ zhes gzungs ring dang*/ tadya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dzye bhai ṣa dzye ma hā bhai ṣa dzye bhai ṣa dzye rā dzā sa muṅga te swā hā/ zhes gzungs thung ste gong 'og gsum po tshang ba bzla thub na phan yon shin tu che zhing*/ de ltar mi nus pa dag gis gzungs thung phyi ma 'di bzlas pas kyang don 'grub bo/ ༈ /de nas khrus gsol ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad la yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi'o// 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod// ces dang rol mo bya zhing de'i bar du/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badzra sā ra pra marda ne/

ta thā ga tā ya arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre/ ma hā badzre/ ma hā te dza badzre/ ma hā bidyā badzre/ ma hā bo dhi tsitta badzre/ ma hā bo dhi maṇḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badzre sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na badzre swā hā/ zhes mchod sbyin gyi gzungs 'di tshar gcig brjod pa'am/ de tsam mi nus na ye dharmā sogs rten 'brel snying po brjod kyang chog ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// rol mo gzungs sngags/ ri bo ltar ni mdzes pa yi// yon tan dam pa'i rgyan ldan pa// mchod gnas rin chen khyed rnams la// bdag cag dad pas sku khrus gsol// rol mo gzungs sngags/ ༈ rnam dag skyon bral byang chub sems kyi dbyings// rnam dag

'di mkhan po bodhi sa twa'i gsung yin pas byin rlabs che'o// skyon bral yon tan tshogs kyi gter// kun gyis phyag byas bstod cing mchod pa'i gnas// bdud bzhi'i dpung rnams ma lus tshar gcod phyir// chos dbyings dag pa'i sku de bzhin sku'i gnas su gsung dang thugs sbyar te sku gsung thugs kha spos/ la khrus chab gsol// nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i rtog pa dag gyur cig /rol mo gzungs sngags/ de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// zhes khrus gsol gyi tshigs bcad re re'i mthar rol mo bya zhing rol mo'i bar la mchod sprin gyi gzungs dang rten 'brel snying po gang rigs bzla ba ma gtogs khrus dang mchod pa'i sngags gzhan nas 'byung ba mdo chog gi skabs su sbyar yang bshad khungs med pas mdo lugs su mi 'gyur ro// de nas ras dkar po kha tshar ma nyams pas sku phyi ba'i tshul bya zhing*/ bde gshegs sku gsum dpe dang mtshan mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i don du gzugs sku cir yang gda'// rin chen dbyig ltar nyes pa'i skyon bral yang*// 'jig rten sri zhu gus pa'i tshul tsam du// sdig med rgyal ba rnams kyis rab bsngags pa'i// ras mchog 'di yis rgyal ba'i sku phyis pas// nyon mongs dug gsum sgrib pa kun sbyangs nas// sku gsum ngang du bdag cag myur 'grub shog /ces dang*/ yang sku la byug pa 'bul tshul gyis/ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung 'gyur ba'i// spos mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// bde gshegs brgyad la snam sbyar sogs na bza' ngur smrig 'bul bar mos te/ dri med mtshan la spros pa mi mnga' yang*// dad pas ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba yis// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba kun// sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog

/'khor rnams la na bza' phul bar mos te/ lha rdzas las byung kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim yid 'ong ldan// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs pa// 'jam dpal skyabs grol sogs la dbul bar bgyi// rgyan 'bul bar mos te/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyan ldan phyir// rgyan gzhan dag gis brgyan par mi 'tshal yang*// rin chen rgyan mchog phul bas 'gro kun gyis// mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku lus thob par shog /mchod pa'i bye brag yo byad 'bul bar mos te/ brtse ba'i 'khor yug snyan pa'i ba dan dang*// ting 'dzin bla bre spobs pa'i 'od gsal ba// mchog rgyan 'os pa'i nyer mkho 'di dag 'bul// skye bos rnam dag ye shes thob par shog /rin chen mdzes pa'i bkra shis bum pa 'di// sna tshogs bcud kyis bkang ste phul ba yis// las dang nyon mongs dri ma kun byang nas// byang chub sems kyi rlan gyis brlan par shog /sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog ༈ /mjug chog gtang rag gi phyag mchod ni/ kun mkhyen kun la gzigs pa'i bcom ldan 'das// ji ltar ji snyed mkhyen pa 'jam dpal dbyangs// yon gnas yon tan gter gyur zhi 'tsho sogs// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// skyob pa sangs rgyas kun dang gnyis su med// legs gsung sgron me ston pa chos kyi rje// ston pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag mchog /drin can bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// snyigs dus 'gro la dgongs pa'i bcom ldan 'das// bde gshegs bdun dang thub dbang dam pa'i chos// 'jam dbyangs skyabs grol phyag rdor 'khor dang bcas// gnod sbyin sde dpon rnams la gus phyag 'tshal// zhes phyag 'tshal dang*/ ༈ 'phags pa'i tshogs de dag thams cad la mchod yon dang byug pa/

me tog dang bdug spos/ mar me dang zhal zas/ rol mo dang sil snyan/ gdugs dang ba dan la sogs pa dngos su ci 'byor pa 'di dag dang*/ phyogs bcu na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung pa'i lha dang mi'i rdzas dam pa bde ba'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang gzungs dang rig pa'i mthu dang mos pa'i stobs kyis bskyed pa'i mchod pa'i sprin phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang*/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba rgya mtsho thams cad kyis nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' klas pa thams cad rgyas par bkang ste 'bul lo// mchod do// bdag cag gis thog ma ma mchis pa nas 'khor ba nas 'khor ba'i tshe rabs thams cad du sdig pa mi dge ba'i las/ mdor na mi bgyi par rigs pa'i las ni bgyis/ bgyi bar 'os pa'i las ma bgyis pa la sogs pa dang dngos sdig ci mchis pa thams cad yang dag par 'chags so// dus gsum gyi 'phags pa dang skye bo'i dge ba'i rtsa ba mtha' dag gi bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo*// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul lo// 'jig rten gyi sgron me gang dag mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston par bzhed pa de dag thams cad la mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 'jig rten gyi don mdzad cing yun du bzhugs par gsol bar 'tshal lo// de ltar bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po ci mchis pa thams cad bdag gzhan ma lus pa bla na med pa'i byang chub mngon du byed pa'i rgyur bsngo'o/ ༈ /de ltar 'dir mdo chog rgyas pa'i skabs 'dod gsol smon lam byung ba rnams lo chen gyis shlo ka gcig pu 'di la btus par snang yang kha skong du tshigs bcad lnga kho bos sbyar ba yin no// bde gshegs 'khor dang bcas rnams la// phyag 'tshal mchod dang sdig bshags yi rang bskul// gsol btab smon lam mthu yis chos rgyal srid// phan bde cher rgyas dam chos ring gnas shog

/de 'dzin mchog rnams sku tshe mdzad phrin rgyas// dge 'dun sde rnams thugs mthun khrims gtsang thob// chos spyod bcu 'phel dkar po'i phyogs 'dzin pa'i// lha klu mi rnams dbu 'phang dgung bstod shog /'jig rten khams su mi bde'i ming med cing*// tshe dpal bsod nams rdzogs ldan dus bzhin 'phel// mtha' yas 'gro ba dge bcu'i lam zhugs nas// mngon mtho'i rten brgyud byang chen myur thob shog /nag po'i phyogs gyur mi dang mi min sogs// bsam sbyor log par 'phyan pa'i tshang tshing kun// mdo sde'i bka' nyan gtum drags gnod sbyin sde'i// mthu stobs ye shes me lces sreg par shog /nyam thag srid pa bar ma'i sems can rnams// 'jigs skrag 'khrul snang ngan song mi myong zhing*// bcom ldan sman bla'i thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis// drangs te dag pa'i zhing mchog bgrod par shog /mdor na 'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge /'khor gsum mtshan ma'i dug dang ma 'dres par// kun bzang 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i rjes 'gro zhing*// rlabs chen smon lam rgya mtshor 'jug par shog /ces brjod/ bzod gsol ni/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal gang*// de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol// dus ngan sems can bsod nams dman// ma rig nyon mongs dang 'dres pas// 'phags pa'i thugs dgongs ma rdzogs pa// de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol// ser sna'i dbang gyur mi mkhas pas// mchod par ngan zhing bshams nyes pa// mgon po thugs rje che ldan pas// de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol// bag med spyod pa ma dag pas// mdo las byung ba'i cho ga bzhin// ma lcogs 'khrul pa ci mchis pa// de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol// lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang*// cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa dang*// bdag gis brjed nges ci mchis pa// de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol// gshegs gsol ni/

de ltar gsol tshe sgo gsum nyes skyon gyis// nongs pa ci bgyis gnong zhing 'gyod pas bshags// bzod par bzhes nas rang rang gnas su bzhud// spyan 'dren tshe na thugs rjes myur gshegs gsol// khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang thugs rjes 'byon par mdzod// ces brjod/ bzang spyod smon lam sogs bsngo smon rgyas pa bya zhing*/ de ltar min yang skabs su babs pa'i smon lam tshigs bcad ci rigs brjod la bkra shis bya ba ni/ rgyal mtshan rtse mor dbang gi rgyal po ltar// lhag pa'i lha yi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa'i// sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /snyigs ma'i 'gro la thugs rje nyi ma'i 'od// ches cher rab 'bar bcom ldan bde gshegs bdun// smon lam gsung ba don kun grub pa sogs// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi bkra shis shog /thos pa tsam gyis srid zhi'i sdug bsngal las// rnam par sgrol nus zab dang rgya che ba'i// snying po sman gyi mdo sde brgyad brgya pa// gsung mchog dam pa'i chos kyi bkra shis shog /zhu gsol srung skyob mdzad pa'i sems dpa' che// nyan thos phyogs skyong gnod sbyin sde dpon sogs// chos 'di yun du 'phel zhing gnas byed pa'i// dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog /gzhan yang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad mdo dang mthun pa brjod la me tog gi char dbab par bya'o// de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi mdo chog nyams su len tshul 'di ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i brgyud 'dzin gyi gtso bo kun mkhyen bsod nams 'phel ba'i thugs sras mkhas pa'i nang na mkhas par gyur pa stag lo smra ba'i nyi mas mdzad pa'i gzhung la bla ma gong ma'i gsung gis kha bskangs te/
